prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: new EIGHT-FRAME farmer WALK DOWN sprite sheet for an existing FHD pixel-art farming game.
Input roles: Image1 RIGHT is the approved farmer identity, body/head/limb/boot size and crisp pixel-art style standard. Image2 DOWN-LEFT is the approved same farmer in front three-quarter, supporting frontal outfit and face/body volume. Image3 OLD DOWN supplies ONLY the front-facing direction and existing eight-phase walking timeline; its thin small-looking arms/body and muted soft rendering are what must be corrected.
Reconstruct the SAME farmer as a DIRECT FRONT VIEW walking SOUTH/DOWN toward the viewer. Both eyes, both shoulders and blue overall bib visible, no side/diagonal/back-facing poses. This farmer must look equally substantial and the SAME character size as images1/2 when shown at equal pixels: native equivalent body64px tall, hat31-32px wide, head about17-19px tall, frontal white-shirt shoulder span17-19px, overall bib13-14px wide, each trouser thigh/shin5-6px, relaxed hand4px, normal compact frontal ankle boots7px wide and7-8px tall. Frontal torso is naturally WIDER than its side view, not a tiny narrow doll. Keep slim adult farmer proportions, NOT fat/chibi, larger head or long skinny legs. Hat/head proportion, warm skin, reddish-brown hair and small readable white sclera with brown-black pupils match images1/2. Straw hat with brown band, short white shirt, blue bib overalls with gold buttons and brown work ankle boots. Same solid connected pixel clusters and strong dark contour as approved farmer; no soft photographic shading or small color noise.
Output4columns by2rows equal cells, exactly8complete unique sprites in row-major phase order1..8. Preserve the proven natural walking progression of oldDOWN image3, drawing improved frontal anatomy at the SAME relative pose in each corresponding cell. Do not invent a new stride. Physical LEFT leg stays attached to SCREEN-RIGHT hip throughout; physical RIGHT leg stays at SCREEN-LEFT hip. Both legs stay visible/connected even when the silhouette overlaps; they alternate weight, knee flexion, raised recovery and contact. Do not swap hip roots or make the same leg forward twice. Contact1: screen-right anatomical LEFT foot forward/down near ground, screen-left RIGHT foot behind/lifted. Passing3: screen-left RIGHT knee bends and its compact boot swings forward under body while LEFT supports. Opposite contact5: screen-left RIGHT foot is forward/down and screen-right LEFT lifted/recovering. Passing7: screen-right LEFT knee bent/recovering while RIGHT supports. Phases2/4/6/8 are continuous small in-between positions, and8 flows into1. No running, huge high-knee hop, boot teleport or slide. Two small arms counter-swing gently opposite their own legs, elbows close to ribs; small hands move smoothly front/back in projection rather than remain frozen or splay sideways. Exactly two arms and two legs, no detached parts.
All poses share one head, hat, torso volume, height range63-65 native pixels, same boot design, same pixel resolution and front-facing camera. Keep heads/hat tops aligned with only tiny body bob. Each figure is comfortably inside its cell with transparent margins and a large clean row gutter. Genuine transparent alpha, no background/shadow/text/frame numbers/guide geometry. Full original-size high-quality crisp PIXEL ART, composed as integer-enlarged ~64px sprites, not a detailed illustration meant to be blurred down. Garment colors follow the existing character reference naturally; this request does not perform a global palette harmonization of any other direction.
